summary: Pro: your scripts and AI assistants can work with Entra Policy Suite, always under each person's own role.

new.title: API for your own scripts (Pro)
new.text: Your scripts reach Entra Policy Suite through its API as the signed-in person, with that person's role. There is no key to hand out, and changes go through the same checks and audit.
new.action: On an existing installation, run the install once more so getting your token needs no extra consent.

new.title: MCP server for AI assistants (Pro)
new.text: AI assistants connect through the MCP server, with the same role, checks and audit as the pages.

new.title: New API and MCP page
new.text: Administration > API and MCP shows your addresses, how to get your token, a script example and the tools your role gets.
